title: DomainPack
description: A declarative description of one business domain: which plugins belong to it, how they group into stages, and what the domain-specific wiring rules are. The audit pack reproduces the values that used to be hardcoded in packages/ai_planner/nebula_graph.py; a second pack (aiops) is what proves the framework is not audit-specific.

discovery.description: Which plugin folders belong to this domain. Replaces the hardcoded `root.glob("audit-*")`.

layers.description: Id segments that mark the non-business layers. A plugin in one of these layers has no stage.

ungrouped_stage.description: Stage key for a business plugin whose segment is not registered. It keeps an unfamiliar plugin visible instead of making it disappear.

segments.description: Id segments that classify a plugin into this stage.

stage_by_plugin.description: Explicit plugin id -> stage overrides. Needed when several plugins share an id segment (aiops.alert-triage and aiops.alert-correlation both segment to `alert`), so segment matching alone cannot separate them.

trunk.description: The closed-loop main ring between stages, for display. It is a visualisation ring: the compiler forbids a cyclic data graph, so this is never emitted as plan edges.

control_segments.description: Id tails of the full-process penetrating control plugins (cross-cutting, not a chain stage).

semantics_ref.description: Path (relative to the pack) of the reviewed semantics catalog for this domain.

prompt.description: System prompt wording for the planner in this domain. Replaces the hardcoded audit-only prompt.
